freeze_discipline.why: Deductive lane, verified exhaustively over finite structures. No threshold, interval or gate is adjusted; nothing is re-run.
freeze_discipline.self_referential_note: Theorem B3 names post-outcome narrowing of an uncertainty set, or movement of a threshold, as the move that manufactures authority without validity. This packet performs neither, and would be self-refuting if it did.

claims_under_test: A1: an orbit-invariant representation yields orbit-invariant decisions.
A2: a decision that moves under a registered semantics-preserving transformation proves the representation is not invariant.
A3: no G-invariant rule can beat the orbit minority-mass floor E*_G.
B1: emitted POSITIVE/NEGATIVE decisions are sound whenever the interval contains the true score.
B2: widening the uncertainty set can only move a decision toward CANNOT_CHECK.
B3: narrowing the set or moving the threshold after outcome access manufactures a decision with no validity guarantee.
